cases.name: Kompressa
referenceLimitations: the bubbles explode 0.6-0.8 SECONDS after they land, which the page says 'may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit' — this engine resolves the blast at the point of impact immediately, so nothing ever escapes one here
the blast needs no line of sight and goes through walls — this arena has no geometry, so nothing is ever behind cover and the perk pays nothing extra
the blast staggers the WIELDER in game — this arena gives the player no body, so a build that would be unplayable in a corridor costs nothing here

cases.name: Cyanex
referenceLimitations: the projectiles HOME on enemies (wiki) — this arena's shots already go where they are aimed, so the homing buys nothing here
the blast needs no line of sight and goes through walls — this arena has no geometry, so nothing is ever behind cover and the perk pays nothing extra
the blast staggers the WIELDER in game — this arena gives the player no body, so a build that would be unplayable in a corridor costs nothing here
the burst empties the MAGAZINE and this entry fires a fixed count — the unmodded magazine. The page states that magazine mods lengthen it, so a build carrying one is understated here

cases.name: Tysis
referenceLimitations: THE INNATE CORROSIVE DoT, which is 81 of this weapon's 130 damage a dart — a `ShotType: DoT` attack of 27 a tick, with each multishot pellet creating its own. Three attacks in the whole game are typed this way and two of them are this weapon's family, so it is recorded rather than built. THE NUMBER ON SCREEN IS THEREFORE ABOUT A THIRD OF THE REAL ONE against a single target
